sources.excerpt: PART I “The learned Attorney-General said that every provision of the Constitution is essential; otherwise it would not have been put in the Constitution. This is true. But this does not place every provision of the Constitution in the same position. The true position is that every provision of the Constitution can be amended provided in the result the basic foundation and structure of the Constitution remains the same. sources.excerpt: bodies of India 5.1 CONSTITUTIONAL AND STATUTORY BODIES Important organizations in India with authority and powers derived from the Indian Constitution are known as constitutional bodies. They have their own articles since they are referenced separately in the constitution. A constitutional amendment would be necessary for any modification to these bodies' operational procedures.
